opportunities.name: JetBlue flight search with price sort
opportunities.description: Search JetBlue flights for a given origin, destination, trip type and dates, then re-sort the results by price.
steps: Open the jetBlue flights search page.
Set trip type (Roundtrip or One-way) if it differs from the default.
Type the origin city into the From field and select the matching airport or metro option.
Type the destination city into the To field and select the matching option.
Click the Depart field, then click the departure date in the calendar.
For roundtrip, click the Return field and click the return date.
Click 'Search flights', then click 'Continue to flight results' in the confirmation dialog.
Click 'Sort & Filter', click the Sort dropdown and choose 'Price (low to high)' or 'Price by Core'.
Click 'Apply'.
parameters: origin city (e.g. New York / NYC / JFK)
sort option (price low to high / Price by Core)

instances.values: From New York JFK, To Miami MIA, roundtrip Mar 27 to Mar 31, sorted by Price by Core, points view toggled on
From New York City area (NYC), To Toronto YYZ, one-way Apr 29, sorted by Price (low to high), JFK and LGA departure airports

opportunities.name: United car rental search by pickup city and dates
opportunities.description: Search United's car rental tab for a pickup city, pickup and drop-off dates and times, then click Find cars.
steps: Click the 'CAR' tab on the booking widget.
Type the pickup city or airport into 'Pickup location' and select the matching suggestion.
Click the Pickup date field and select the pickup date in the calendar.
Select the drop-off date in the calendar.
Open the 'Pickup time' dropdown and choose the pickup time.
Open the 'Drop off time' dropdown and choose the drop-off time.
Click 'Find cars'.

instances.values: Pickup Caldwell (Ohio), US; Apr 8 to Apr 13; pickup 8:00 a.m., drop-off 12:00 p.m.; Book with miles checked
Pickup Brooklyn - Central (New York), US; Apr 9 to Apr 15; pickup and drop-off both at the default 10:00 a.m.

opportunities.name: Avis Budget careers job search filtered by country, team and time type
opportunities.description: Open the Avis Budget Group Openings page and filter jobs by country, team and time type, then run the search.
steps: Open the Careers link on the Budget site, then the 'Openings' link.
Click the 'Country' filter and choose the country from the search box list.
Click the 'Team' filter and choose the team from the list.
Click the 'Time Type' filter and choose 'Full time' or 'Part time'.
Click 'Search by job title or keyword'.
Optionally open a result from the list.

instances.values: Country United States of America, Team Finance, Time Type Full time; search returned 26 jobs; then opened Accounts Payable Associate (t=1294.2 to 1297.3)
Country United States of America, Team Finance, Time Type Full time; same filters repeated from the Careers page

opportunities.name: Product search with max-price filter on e-commerce sites
opportunities.description: Search a product on a retail site, apply a maximum price or delivery/sort filter, and act on a chosen result.
steps: Click the site's search box and type the product keyword, then submit.
Locate the price filter (Max or Maximum Price field) and type the maximum price.
Click 'GO' or the filter's apply button.
Optionally apply another filter or sort (free delivery, total price).
Click the desired product's 'Add to Cart' or 'Choose option' button, or open the product page and add it to cart.
parameters: product keyword (e.g. swivel vacuum, wireless headphones, granitestone sandwich maker)

instances.values: Menards: keyword 'swivel vacuum', max price 150, added first result to cart
Google Shopping: keyword 'Granitestone Sandwich Maker', then Free delivery filter and Total price column sort (no max price)
Amazon: keyword 'wireless headphones', max price 100, opened the EAORUL product and clicked Add to Cart

opportunities.name: NPS Find a Park filtered search by activity or topic
opportunities.description: On nps.gov Find a Park, filter parks by an activity or topic and run the search to list matching parks.
steps: Click 'FIND A PARK' on the NPS homepage.
Click 'Search by Activity or Topic'.
Open the 'Activity' (or 'Topic') dropdown.
Tick the desired activity or topic checkbox.
Click 'Search'.
Scroll the results list (470 or 20 shown per page).
parameters: filter value (e.g. Junior Ranger Program, Industry, Laborer and Worker)

instances.values: Activity filter set to Junior Ranger Program, then Search
Topic filter set to Industry, Laborer and Worker, then Search

opportunities.name: MTA toll rates lookup by vehicle type
opportunities.description: Navigate the MTA site to the tolls-by-vehicle page and open the rate table for a chosen vehicle type.
steps: Open the MTA site and click the menu or 'Fares & Tolls' link.
Navigate to the Bridges & Tunnels (or Bridges and Tunnels tolls) page.
Click 'Tolls by vehicle' or the Toll Rates card.
Click the card for the vehicle type (Cars, Motorcycles, Trucks).
Read the rate table for the chosen vehicle.
parameters: navigation route (Menu > Agencies, or Fares & Tolls)

instances.values: Menu > Agencies > Bridges & Tunnels > Tolls by vehicle > Cars
Fares & Tolls > Bridges and Tunnels tolls > Tolls by vehicle > Motorcycles, opened Bronx-Whitestone rate row
